notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other Humans and/or Wizards.
description:
Activate Seal of Removal by sacrificing it, returning Auramancer to your hand.
Cast Auramancer by paying {3}.
When Auramancer enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Auramancer trigger, returning Seal of Removal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {4}.
Cast Seal of Removal by paying {1}.
Repeat.
If you control five or more Humans and/or Wizards, this combo nets infinite mana.
